args.title: venice: deterministic read-only SEC/options workflow schedule audit
args.body:
Task workflow-schedule-audit-v1. Gantt: [1 Data / SEC / analyst / sector history] + [1 Data / Options + money-flow (#165)].

Adds a read-only inventory of configured SEC/options workflow triggers and source hashes: `agent/workflow_schedule_audit.py`, tests in `tests/test_workflow_schedule_audit.py`, fixtures, request metadata, docs in `docs/VENICE_WORKFLOW_SCHEDULE_AUDIT_V1.md`, and a branch-triggered CI workflow `.github/workflows/venice-workflow-schedule-audit.yml`.

Evidence: branch run https://github.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/actions/runs/42507126338 succeeded on sha a5deb2c4ba100e83609556312a92bb4f6d8030ea (artifact workflow-schedule-audit-42507126338, sha256 4a4bb7cad513e73257beebce2eaa1ea7a354aea678652cda5c857fd4cc1774be). Earlier run 42506461802 failed and was superseded.

The tool reports only what workflow files declare; it never claims a scheduled run happened or was missed. No collectors or production pipeline workflows are modified. Publication only through the task-scoped checked merge route.
